snippets.snippet_text: "Starting Jan 1, 2023, to comply with local laws, Etsy will start withholding taxes from the sales of sellers in Mexico to cover impuesto sobre la renta (ISR) and impuesto al valor agregado (IVA). These funds will then go to the Servicio de Administración Tributaria (SAT). The amount Etsy is required to withhold can be as high as 36% of the order total, however if you register for a Registro Federal de Contribuyentes (RFC) identification number and add it to your Etsy account, significantly less tax (see more below) will be withheld from your Etsy sales."
